firstPlayerRule: The last player to have spotted a real unicorn becomes the first player and takes the First Player token.
clarifications: The rule is a joke: the booklet gives no practical procedure when nobody has spotted a real unicorn.
For later hunts, the player who wins a unicorn becomes the new first player.
internalEvidence: Don’t Panic Games hosts the Morning-branded English PDF. PDF page 7 was rendered and read for the opening rule; page 16 text states the hunt-winner transfer. The hunt cards, scheme cards and title match inventory BGG 204602. SHA-256: f0bb6dca8353ded1f162b98f562c59be432826c04d6a0e388472c8540e04857b. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the exact opening instruction, game identity and edition against the cited rendered rulebook. Label edit 2026-09-25: removed file/print bookkeeping from the edition label; rule content unchanged.
uncertainty: The manual does not provide a workable initial fallback for players who have never seen a real unicorn.
